title: Clicking on first virtual desktop briefly visually highlights the fourth
line: Clicking a window in the Pager no longer makes another desktop flash as highlighted.
explanation: Releasing the mouse on a window outline in the Pager always called pagerModel.refresh(), even for a plain click that only switches desktop. The refresh resets the model and recreates every desktop cell, and while the cells are rebuilt the last one briefly shows the hover state, so desktop 4 flashed for about 100 ms. The change only resets the model after a real drag, where it is still needed to put the reparented outline back.

commits.message:
applets/pager: don't reset the model when clicking a window outline

Every release on a window outline reset the pager model, even a plain
click that only switches desktop, and the rebuilt desktops briefly showed
the last one as hovered. Only reset the model after a drag.

BUG: 505574

media.caption: Frames before, during and after clicking Dolphin's outline in desktop 1 (from desktop 2): desktop 4 flashes highlighted
Same frames with the fix: only desktop 1 is highlighted
Three clicks on the outline, half speed: desktop 4 flashes each time
Same three clicks with the fix: no flash
